description: A sample and hold with a white noise source of its own, offering track and hold and hold and track as well, and a slew limiter on the way out

params.text: Picks the mode, shown as SH, TH or HT: Sample and hold takes a voltage on each trigger; Track and hold follows the input while the trigger is low and freezes it while high; Hold and track the reverse
Produces a trigger for as long as it is held down, exactly as a high voltage at the clock input does
Sets how slowly the output may change, from no limit at the bottom of the slider up to 10 seconds per volt at the top

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2V takes a new sample, and the module counts the input high until it falls below 0.1V
The voltage the module samples or tracks; with nothing patched here the internal white noise generator is sampled instead
Shifts the slew time; each volt doubles it, so the slider can be taken past its own maximum

outputs.text: The internal white noise generator, available whether or not it is being sampled
The held or tracked voltage, after the slew limiter

notes: With nothing in the voltage input the module samples its own white noise, so it produces random voltages as soon as it is clocked.
The moon changes colour and brightness with the output voltage: one colour above 0.99V, another below -0.99V and a third between the two.
menu: Store held voltage in patch — saves the voltage at the output with the patch, so it comes back on load instead of starting at 0V; on by default, and found on the Options submenu
Draw moon halo — draws a halo in the moon's own colour around the moon light; on by default, and found on the Options submenu
